input.cause: The refusal is real and true, and it comes from the harness's schema check on procedure.analyse, before any guard. In the 7 tasks the model (claude-sonnet-5-5) sent `evidence`, and in 5 of them also `changes`, as something other than an array. The words that describe analyse (specs/procedure/words.json /capabilities/analyse) only say "the evidence in the last test's record" and "the changes ... each a field of the procedure". They never say that evidence and changes are arrays, or what an item holds. The model has to guess the shape and is told only "data/evidence must be array", with no expected shape. The sent arguments are not kept, so the exact wrong shape is not visible. The failure is recoverable: in exp7-fixes/t-2026-09-30-0004 step 7 was refused and step 8 completed. The cause is a gap in the contract's texts (an unstated argument shape), not a guard rule and not an output cut.

predictions.alternative: the call was cut at the output limit, truncating the JSON so that evidence was no longer an array
a guard rule on the content of the analysis refused it, not the harness schema
